analysis.purpose: The single source of truth for the code graph: a chunked-JSONL store on disk plus an in-memory graph model, written by exactly one writer and flushed atomically so an unchanged source re-indexes byte-for-byte identically.
responsibilities: Hydrate the full node/edge graph into memory on load
Validate every write against the vendored JSON Schema before accepting it
Route each record to a shard derived from its source path
Flush atomically (temp then rename) on commit
Keep on-disk records id-sorted so re-indexing is byte-stable

businessRules.rule: All pipeline writes land in the soul first; the search index is derived from it and never written directly.
businessRules.rationale: Keeps one authoritative graph and makes the index safely rebuildable.

businessRules.rule: Records are sorted by id within each chunk so an unchanged source re-indexes byte-identically.
businessRules.rationale: This is the determinism gate that makes cache-stability checks meaningful.

edges.rationale: This file implements the store that owns the graph on disk.
